      "category": "bridged_nets",

      "pins": ["FCC1.73", "FCC1.48", "UART3_FCC1.3", "UART3_FCC1.4"],
      "nets": ["UART3_RX_FCC", "UART3_TX_FCC"],
      "observed": "The UART3 connector's TX and RX lines are tied to FCC1 pins 48 and 73, which are the STM32H753 VCAP pins (internal core-regulator output, power_out). FCC1 PB10 (pin 46) is flagged no_connect, so no MCU UART3 pin carries these signals.",
      "expected": "UART3 TX/RX should be routed to ordinary GPIO/USART alternate-function pins. The VCAP pins should only connect to their own decoupling capacitors and must not carry signals.",
      "evidence": [
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(net (code \"144\") (name \"UART3_RX_FCC\") (class \"Default\") (node (ref \"FCC1\") (pin \"73\") (pinfunction \"VCAP\") (pintype \"power_out\"))"},
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(net (code \"146\") (name \"UART3_TX_FCC\") (class \"Default\") (node (ref \"FCC1\") (pin \"48\") (pinfunction \"VCAP\") (pintype \"power_out\"))"},
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(node (ref \"FCC1\") (pin \"46\") (pinfunction \"PB10\") (pintype \"bidirectional+no_connect\"))"}
      ],
      "impact": "The UART3 signals are shorted to the MCU's internal core-supply regulator output, which will corrupt or prevent the core supply and make the FCC unreliable. UART3 is also unusable as a serial link.",
      "confidence": 0.7
    },
    {
      "category": "wrong_component_type",
      "components": ["U2", "PCA9685PW"],
      "pins": ["U2.1", "U2.2"],
      "nets": ["+3V3", "GND"],
      "observed": "PCA9685 address pin A0 (U2 pin 1) is tied to +3V3 while A1 through A5 are on GND, which sets the 7-bit I2C address to 0x41.",
      "expected": "The specification lists the PCA9685PW at I2C address 0x40, which requires all address pins (A0 to A5) to be low.",
      "evidence": [
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(net (code \"2\") (name \"+3V3\") (class \"Default\") ... (node (ref \"U2\") (pin \"1\") (pinfunction \"A0\") (pintype \"input\"))"},
        {"source": "spec", "quote": "NXP PCA9685PW (I2C 16-ch PWM), I2C addr 0x40"}
      ],
      "impact": "The firmware addressing the PWM driver at 0x40 gets no response, so servo outputs cannot be commanded.",
      "confidence": 0.5
    },
    {
      "category": "open_connection",
      "components": ["FCC1", "NAVC1", "NRST_FCC", "NRST_NAVC", "SW1", "SW5"],
      "pins": ["FCC1.14", "NAVC1.7"],
      "nets": ["unconnected-(FCC1-NRST-Pad14)", "unconnected-(NAVC1-NRST-Pad7)", "NRST_FCC", "NRST_NAVC"],
      "observed": "The NRST pins of both MCUs sit on their own single-pin nets. The reset capacitors (C31, C49), reset switches (SW1, SW5) and SWD connector reset pins are on separate NRST_FCC and NRST_NAVC nets that never reach the MCUs.",
      "expected": "NRST on each MCU should connect to the reset network, so the reset switch and debug-port reset work.",
      "evidence": [
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(net (code \"174\") (name \"unconnected-(FCC1-NRST-Pad14)\") (class \"Default\") (node (ref \"FCC1\") (pin \"14\") (pinfunction \"NRST\") (pintype \"input\")))"},
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(net (code \"61\") (name \"NRST_FCC\") (class \"Default\") (node (ref \"C31\") (pin \"1\") (pintype \"passive\")) (node (ref \"SW1\") (pin \"1\") ..."},
        {"source": "netlist", "quote": "(net (code \"224\") (name \"unconnected-(NAVC1-NRST-Pad7)\") (class \"Default\") (node (ref \"NAVC1\") (pin \"7\") (pinfunction \"NRST\") (pintype \"input\")))"}
      ],
      "impact": "The MCUs cannot be reset externally or by the reset circuit, and the debug/reset path is broken. Reset-related startup behaviour and recovery are affected.",
      "confidence": 0.35
    }
  ],
  "summary": "The netlist shows UART3 signals shorted to the FCC1 VCAP power-output pins, which is a clear bridged-net error. The PCA9685 address strap also contradicts the specified 0x40 address, and the MCU NRST pins are disconnected from their reset network."
}

anomalies.observed: The UART3 connector's TX and RX lines are tied to FCC1 pins 48 and 73, which are the STM32H753 VCAP pins (internal core-regulator output, power_out). FCC1 PB10 (pin 46) is flagged no_connect, so no MCU UART3 pin carries these signals.
anomalies.expected: UART3 TX/RX should be routed to ordinary GPIO/USART alternate-function pins. The VCAP pins should only connect to their own decoupling capacitors and must not carry signals.
anomalies.impact: The UART3 signals are shorted to the MCU's internal core-supply regulator output, which will corrupt or prevent the core supply and make the FCC unreliable. UART3 is also unusable as a serial link.

anomalies.observed: PCA9685 address pin A0 (U2 pin 1) is tied to +3V3 while A1 through A5 are on GND, which sets the 7-bit I2C address to 0x41.
anomalies.expected: The specification lists the PCA9685PW at I2C address 0x40, which requires all address pins (A0 to A5) to be low.
anomalies.impact: The firmware addressing the PWM driver at 0x40 gets no response, so servo outputs cannot be commanded.

anomalies.observed: The NRST pins of both MCUs sit on their own single-pin nets. The reset capacitors (C31, C49), reset switches (SW1, SW5) and SWD connector reset pins are on separate NRST_FCC and NRST_NAVC nets that never reach the MCUs.
anomalies.expected: NRST on each MCU should connect to the reset network, so the reset switch and debug-port reset work.
anomalies.impact: The MCUs cannot be reset externally or by the reset circuit, and the debug/reset path is broken. Reset-related startup behaviour and recovery are affected.
